- **Diplodia reference**: White/tan mold - no match.
- **Gibberella reference**: Pink/red mold at ear tip - no match.

The dark teal/blue-green mold distributed between kernels throughout the ear matches Trichoderma_Ear_Rot best. Aspergillus is more powdery and olive-toned; the test image's mold color is distinctly darker/bluer-green.
